column3: Being comforted is rendered as having received comfort.
“Felt” is supplied with having the sentence of death.
“In answer to their prayers” specifies through many.
The things read or understood are rendered as being within their ability; to the end is rendered as “completely.”
Being each other’s boast is rendered as boasting of one another.
Second grace is rendered as “a double blessing.”
“When I really mean” adds an explicit contrast to yes and no.
“Christ” specifies Him; “our” and “is spoken” are supplied with Amen.
“Of what is to come” explains the pledge.
Upon my soul is not expressed.
